fields.description: The visit this was ordered on, when it was ordered on one. Optional, unlike Lab: a preventive dose is routinely given on a pet's record with no visit at all, and that direct case is a first-class path rather than an exception.
fields.label: Visit

fields.description: What ordered this, when it was not a Vet Visit - a Pet Boarding, say. A real Link, not a marker parsed out of free text.
fields.label: Source Name

fields.description: The practitioner who ORDERED this, taken from the visit. Distinct from Administering Practitioner on purpose: a doctor orders the vaccination during the consult and a nurse gives it, and the clinic knows both.
fields.label: Ordering Practitioner

fields.description: The practitioner who actually ADMINISTERED the dose. Set when the record is started.
fields.label: Administering Practitioner

fields.description: The catalogue row this reads its item, price and drug from. Either this or Service Option must be set - vaccination is configured as a template, deworming as weight bands.
fields.label: Care Service

fields.description: The weight band picked for this dose. Carries the price and the stock deduction quantity for deworming.
fields.label: Service Option

fields.description: Resolved from the catalogue category at insert and then frozen, so a later category rename cannot retroactively re-describe a dose that has already been given.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: Defaulted from the band, else the template. Left alone once set, so a deliberate substitution is never silently overwritten by the catalogue.
fields.label: Medication

fields.description: The label this dose is recorded and billed under. Replaces the separate vaccine_name and medication_name of the two record doctypes this supersedes.
fields.label: Administered

fields.description: Hand-entered only. Never filled automatically - batch tracking is not configured, and a guessed lot number on a vaccination record is worse than an empty one.
fields.label: Batch No

fields.description: The pet's weight at the time of dosing. This is what selects the deworming band.
fields.label: Weight (kg)

fields.description: How much of the drug this dose consumes, defaulted from the band and overridable for a partial dose. Precision 4 deliberately: a sixth of a tablet is 0.1667 and must survive this site's float precision of 2.
fields.label: Quantity

fields.description: When this dose is due to happen. Optional, and never defaulted - an absent value means 'do it now', which is most doses. A stamp written automatically would be indistinguishable from one a person chose, and nothing could then tell a scheduled dose from an unscheduled one.
fields.label: Scheduled Datetime

fields.description: The date of the NEXT dose, chosen by the operator and never computed. Empty is a real answer meaning no recurrence: no reminder is raised and nothing is reported.
fields.label: Next Due Date

fields.description: Which clinic this record belongs to. Stamped from the acting user at insert and used to scope worklists. Distinct from Performing Branch, which comes from the catalogue and says where the service is physically carried out - blank on every catalogue row today.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Where this dose was given. Snapshotted from the catalogue at insert and never rewritten by a later catalogue edit.
fields.label: Performing Branch

fields.description: What actually left the shelf. Recorded, never recomputed, so a cancellation reverses the real quantity even if the band is edited afterwards.
fields.label: Stock Issued Qty
